hotel.name: Harbor View Hotel
hotel.breakfast: Complimentary breakfast is served daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM in the lobby restaurant.
hotel.cancellation_policy: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before arrival. Cancellations within 48 hours are subject to the first night charge.

amenities.swimming_pool: Outdoor rooftop pool open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM.
amenities.gym: 24-hour fitness center with cardio and strength equipment.
amenities.restaurant: The Harbor Table serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
amenities.parking: On-site parking is available for a daily fee of $35.
amenities.wifi: Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the property.
amenities.room_service: Room service is available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Comfortable room with city views and a work desk.

rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.description: Spacious room with a lounge chair and upgraded bath amenities.

rooms.name: Family Suite
rooms.description: Two-bedroom style suite designed for families and longer stays.

rooms.name: Junior Suite
rooms.description: A flexible layout for families or business travelers needing extra space.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before arrival.
policies.pets: Pets are welcome with a $35 per night fee and prior approval.
policies.smoking: The hotel is entirely smoke-free indoors and on balconies.
policies.children: Children 12 and under stay free in existing bedding.
policies.extra_beds: Extra beds are available for $45 per night, subject to room type availability.

faqs.question: Is breakfast included?
faqs.answer: Yes, complimentary breakfast is available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM.

faqs.question: Is parking available?
faqs.answer: Yes, on-site parking is available for a daily fee of $35.

faqs.question: Do you have WiFi?
faqs.answer: Yes, complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the hotel.

faqs.question: Do you have a pool?
faqs.answer: Yes, the hotel has an outdoor rooftop pool open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

faqs.question: Do you have a gym?
faqs.answer: Yes, our 24-hour fitness center is available to all guests.
